title: Tenant-Setting Feature Gates (disabled-setting teaching errors)
summary: Many Fabric features are gated by a tenant setting an admin can toggle. When a setting is disabled the API returns an opaque 403 FeatureNotAvailable; fabio turns this into an admin-aware teaching error that names the exact setting and (for admins) the command to enable it. Do NOT blindly retry a feature-disabled error.

how_it_works.detection: fabio detects a feature-disabled error generically (FeatureNotAvailable / TenantSwitchDisabled / 'not enabled in the tenant' / 'tenant setting ... disabled') for ANY command, then probes whether the caller is a Fabric admin.
how_it_works.admin_aware_hint: Admin caller -> the error hint gives the exact enable command: fabio admin update-tenant-setting --setting-name <NAME> --content '{"enabled": true}'. Non-admin caller -> the hint says to ask an admin (no command they cannot run). Unknown -> a non-committal hint plus 'fabio admin list-tenant-settings' to find it.
how_it_works.named_setting: For registered features the hint NAMES the exact tenant setting and lists non-gated fallbacks; for unregistered features a generic admin-aware hint still fires (never an opaque failure).
how_it_works.hint_type: The error is a FORBIDDEN with hintType semantic_correction — treat it as a gate to clear, not a transient error to retry.

agent_guidance: On a feature-disabled FORBIDDEN, read the named setting from the hint. If you are (or the user is) a Fabric admin, enabling is a one-liner: fabio admin update-tenant-setting --setting-name <NAME> --content '{"enabled": true}'. Otherwise surface the setting name to the user and ask an admin to enable it.
Do NOT auto-retry the same command without addressing the gate — it will fail identically.
Prefer any fallback the hint offers (e.g. 'semantic-model query --dax' when the Power BI MCP setting is off).
Some tenant settings gate only the portal UI and do NOT affect the REST path — if a command works, the setting is not gating it.

known_gated_features.PowerBIMCP: semantic-model generate-dax / copilot-schema, report copilot-metadata (fallback: query --dax, list-tables, report get-definition)
known_gated_features.AllowSendAOAIDataToOtherRegions: ontology NL search (Fabric IQ) when the capacity region lacks in-region Azure OpenAI

discovering_settings: fabio admin list-tenant-settings (requires Fabric admin) lists every setting with its title and enabled state; match on the title to find the exact settingName.
